# Code of conduct

ZPadder follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short:

- Be welcoming and patient, whoever you are and whatever your experience. Many people come here
  because an old tool stopped working for them; help them get going.
- Disagree about the work, never the person. Assume good faith, and accept that a maintainer may
  decide differently than you would.
- No harassment, insults, sexualised language or imagery, personal or political attacks, or
  publishing anyone's private information.
- Keep it on topic. ZPadder doesn't help anyone cheat or evade anti-cheat (see
  [docs/anti-cheat.md](../docs/anti-cheat.md)), and requests for that will be closed.

This applies in the repository's issues, pull requests and discussions, and anywhere else you
represent the project.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour bothers you, report it privately: open the **···** menu on the comment,
issue or pull request and choose **Report content**. Reports go to the maintainers, and only
to them. You can also report the account to GitHub itself.

The maintainers will look at every report, keep the reporter's identity private, and respond as
the Contributor Covenant's enforcement guidelines describe: from a private warning to a
temporary or permanent ban, depending on how serious and how repeated the behaviour is.
